notes.title: Official demo release scheduled for Friday, March 21!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289174/1bfd720624f19f43caf8fd272c9d308c80348e78.png[/img]

[b]On [u]Friday, March 21 (KST)[/u], the official demo of My Little Puppy will be released![/b]

Join Bong-gu’s heartfelt journey as he sets off to reunite with his father who has just arrived in the afterlife. 
Experience [b]the first steps[/b] of this touching adventure in the official demo! 🐶✨

[b]Wishlist & Follow My Little Puppy now to receive the latest updates and be the first to play the demo! 😊[/b]
